query: What is Meridian's ARR growth rate and net revenue retention?
answer:
Based on the provided documents, here is Meridian's performance:

**ARR Growth Rate:** 34.2% year-over-year in FY2023, growing from $28.4 million in FY2022 to $38.1 million in FY2023 [doc_001]. However, this growth rate is projected to slow to 22% in FY2024 according to revised analyst estimates [doc_003].

**Net Revenue Retention (NRR):** 118% as of FY2023 [doc_001]. Earlier data from Q2 2023 showed NRR of 116% [doc_002], and at the time of the Series C closing in May 2023, NRR was 114% [doc_004].

context.content:
TECH PRESS ARTICLE — Meridian rumored $500M valuation based on public market chatter, not internal diligence or Atlas materials.
March 28, 2024 | PUBLIC NEWS SOURCE

Fintech Market Wire has learned from two people familiar with recent financing conversations that Meridian Technologies may be seeking strategic alternatives at a rumored $500M valuation. The figure appears to be based on public SaaS multiples, Meridian's reported $38.1M FY2023 ARR, and prior growth commentary from third-party research notes.

The rumored valuation conflicts with more conservative internal buyer work that values Meridian closer to the mid-$300M range after factoring in slower FY2024 ARR growth, customer concentration, and revised new-logo assumptions. Atlas Capital declined to comment. Meridian also declined to comment on any sale process.

Market observers note that regional-bank infrastructure assets remain attractive despite a cooler software M&A environment. Meridian's ClearFlow platform has strong retention metrics and a credible product niche, but buyers are said to be focused on the company's top-customer exposure and the timing of a major enterprise renewal in August 2024.

This article is based entirely on public filings, market checks, and investor conversations. It does not reflect confidential diligence, board materials, lender workpapers, or any non-public financial model.

FORM 10-K — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023
EXCERPT: BUSINESS OVERVIEW AND SELECTED FINANCIAL DATA

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Meridian Technologies, Inc. is a B2B fintech platform headquartered in Austin, Texas. The Company
provides embedded payment infrastructure and real-time reconciliation software to mid-market and
enterprise financial institutions across the United States. Meridian's flagship product, ClearFlow,
enables banks and financial institutions to automate payment exception handling and back-office
reconciliation at scale.

regional banks. Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) grew from $28.4 million in fiscal year 2022 to
$38.1 million in fiscal year 2023, representing 34.2% year-over-year growth.

  Net Revenue Retention (NRR):         118%
  Cash and Cash Equivalents:           $22.6 million
  Long-Term Debt:                      $0
  Headcount:                           214 full-time employees

RISK FACTORS (SUMMARY)

Management identifies the following as primary business risks:

RESEARCH NOTE UPDATE — MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES
Summit Financial Research | January 15, 2024

MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES: REVISING ESTIMATES DOWNWARD; RATING MAINTAINED AT BUY

We are revising our September 2023 financial projections for Meridian Technologies following
the release of Q3 2023 earnings data and updated channel checks.

REVISION SUMMARY

Our FY2024 ARR growth estimate is revised downward from 35% to 22%, reflecting:

  — Slower-than-expected enterprise contract closings: one of two anticipated H1 2024
    top-20 bank signings has been pushed to H2 2024 per management commentary
  — Customer concentration risk is higher than our September 2023 assessment. Updated
    channel checks indicate Meridian's top three customers now represent approximately
    58–62% of ARR, up from ~45% cited in our initiation note
  — Delayed FX module launch (rescheduled from Q4 2023 to Q2 2024)

UPDATED FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS

  FY2024 ARR estimate (revised):   $46.5 million  (prior: $51.4 million)
  Gross margin assumption:          71%  (unchanged)
  Revised EV range:                 $300–$360 million

MAINTAINED BUY RATIONALE
context.title: Summit Financial Research — Meridian Estimate Revision (Q4 2023)

context.content:
RESEARCH NOTE — MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES
COVERAGE INITIATION
Summit Financial Research | September 20, 2023

MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES: INITIATING COVERAGE WITH BUY

We initiate coverage of Meridian Technologies with a BUY rating and a base-case enterprise
value target of $480 million.

INVESTMENT THESIS

Meridian is positioned to capture significant share in the $14 billion back-office reconciliation
and embedded payments market. Its ClearFlow platform has demonstrated strong product-market fit
with regional banks, a segment underserved by legacy processors. Net Revenue Retention of 116%
as of Q2 2023 supports a durable land-and-expand revenue model.

FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS

We project 35% ARR growth in fiscal year 2024, driven by:

  — Two new top-20 bank contract signings expected in H1 2024
  — Expansion revenue from existing clients as reconciliation volumes grow
  — Planned launch of FX and multi-currency modules in Q4 2023

  FY2024 ARR estimate:     $51.4 million
  Valuation basis:          12.5x ARR multiple → EV $642 million
  Risk-adjusted base case:  $480 million enterprise value

RISKS

  — Revenue concentration: approximately 45% of ARR from top two customers
  — Execution risk on new product launches
  — Dependency on regional bank vertical health

We view near-term concentration risk as manageable given Meridian's strong NRR and the
company's growing client diversification strategy. New logo pipeline for H2 2023 appears
robust based on our channel checks with industry contacts.
context.title: Summit Financial Research — Meridian Coverage Initiation (Q3 2023)

context.content:
MAINTAINED BUY RATIONALE

Despite the downward revision, we maintain our BUY rating. Meridian's NRR of 118% (per
preliminary FY2023 data) remains a key differentiator. The ClearFlow platform's stickiness
within regional bank workflows is difficult to displace, and we view the contract delay as
a timing issue rather than structural demand erosion.

The customer concentration increase warrants monitoring. We expect Meridian to actively
diversify its customer base through 2024 as the sales team scales.

Rating: BUY | Revised EV Target: $340M | Date: January 15, 2024
(Replaces September 20, 2023 research note)

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES CLOSES $45 MILLION SERIES C FINANCING

Austin, TX — June 15, 2023 — Meridian Technologies, Inc., a leading provider of embedded payment
infrastructure for financial institutions, today announced the closing of a $45 million Series C
financing round. The round was led by Parkview Growth Equity, with participation from existing
investors Bridgewater Ventures and Cascade Capital.

Meridian will use the proceeds to accelerate product development, expand its enterprise sales team,
and pursue strategic partnerships within the U.S. regional banking sector.

"We built ClearFlow to solve a real infrastructure problem for banks trying to modernize without
ripping out legacy systems," said CEO James Hartley. "This funding gives us the runway to double
down on what's working and expand into adjacent workflows."

COMPANY HIGHLIGHTS AT TIME OF CLOSING:

  — ARR:               $27.1 million (as of May 2023)
  — Net Revenue Retention:  114%
  — Enterprise Clients:     39 financial institutions
  — Employees:          168 full-time

Parkview Growth Equity Partner Sandra Yuen added: "Meridian is one of the most capital-efficient
fintech infrastructure companies we have evaluated. The ClearFlow platform has become deeply
embedded in its clients' operations, and we believe the opportunity in regional bank modernization
is still in the early innings."

The Series C brings Meridian's total funding to $72 million since founding in 2018.
context.title: Meridian Technologies — Series C Press Release

context.content:
RISK FACTORS (SUMMARY)

Management identifies the following as primary business risks:

  (i)  Customer revenue concentration — the Company's three largest customers represent
       approximately 58% of ARR as of December 31, 2023.
  (ii) Dependence on continued adoption of embedded finance solutions by regional banking
       institutions, which may be affected by regulatory changes or macroeconomic conditions.
  (iii) Competitive pressure from established payments infrastructure providers, including
       large technology companies entering the reconciliation automation market.

FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS

This filing contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities
Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Actual results may differ materially from those projected.
Meridian Technologies makes no representation as to the accuracy of projections beyond the
reporting period.
